component.name: KTodo
component.summary: Manage your Todoist tasks natively on Plasma

description.p: KTodo is a Todoist client built with Kirigami and Qt Quick, so it looks and behaves like the rest of your Plasma desktop rather than a packaged web page.
Everything is cached locally and edits are queued, so the app stays usable with no connection and replays your changes when you reconnect.

ul.li: Works offline, with changes queued until you reconnect
Today and Upcoming views, saved filters and labels
Team projects with assignees and comment threads
Due dates, recurring schedules, deadlines and priorities
Drag and drop to reorder tasks and move them between sections

description.p: KTodo is an unofficial client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Doist, the makers of Todoist. A Todoist account is required.

screenshot.caption: The Today view, with projects and saved filters in the sidebar
Editing a task, including its schedule, labels and assignee

ul.li: Add an Upcoming agenda with a calendar navigator.
Group overdue tasks with collapse and bulk rescheduling controls.
Add recurring schedules to the Add Task dialog.

description.p: Fix Show Completed Tasks, which left the list empty.
Collapse and expand subtasks in the task list.
Add native Debian and RPM release packages.
Package OAuth client credentials in release artifacts.
